children: Moncler's historic track record of delivering positive results in its peak trading season could be partially offset by a likely soft third quarter, RBC Capital Markets' Piral Dadhania says. The Italian high-end fashion company, known for its puffer jackets, typically posts a good sales performance in winter. "[Macroeconomic] and luxury demand conditions have incrementally softened in our view and we find ourselves reducing estimates across the board, to which Moncler is not immune," the analyst writes in a note. The stock trades 0.2% lower. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
